questions.question: Choose correct statement/s about anemia of chronic diseases
options: It is associated with decreased plasma concentrations of ferritin and transferrin
Hepcidin level increases due to pro-inflammatory mediators
Patients usually have severe iron deficiency and very low plasma iron level
IL 2 and IL 8 play a major role in the pathogenesis of this anemia
It can be caused by Crohn’s disease
questions.explanation: The displayed Moodle feedback lists: “It can be caused by Crohn’s disease” and “Hepcidin level increases due to pro-inflammatory mediators.” This reproduces the source key.

questions.question: Choose the correct statement about pain
options: Disorders of pain perception include allodynia, paraparesis and analgesia
Hypoxia of the internal organs can cause visceral pain
Colicky pain is typical for GERD
Trigeminal neuralgia usually causes nociceptive pain
Pain is a subjective symptom
questions.explanation: The displayed Moodle feedback lists: “Hypoxia of the internal organs can cause visceral pain” and “Pain is a subjective symptom.” This reproduces the source key.

questions.question: Hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis
options: It develops in patients with diarrhea
It develops in patients with vomiting
It develops in patients with a NaCl intake of 5–8 g/day
It develops in patients with reduced absorption of HCO3− in the proximal tubules of the kidneys
It develops in patients with long-term starvation
questions.explanation: The displayed Moodle feedback states: “It develops in patients with vomiting.” This reproduces the source key.

questions.question: Choose the correct statement about stress starvation
options: Ketone bodies are often elevated
Severe emotional stress (e.g. the death of a partner) is one of the most important causes
It is characterized by intense catabolism of proteins
Glucose level often increases
Insulin levels are usually decreased
questions.explanation: The displayed Moodle feedback lists: “It is characterized by intense catabolism of proteins” and “Glucose level often increases.” The student selected only one of these. This reproduces the feedback, rather than the student’s selection.

questions.question: For classification of edema, following characteristic/s is/are used...
options: Pitting and non-pitting
Primary and secondary lymphedema
Local and generalized
Acquired and inherited
Hyperosmolar and hypoosmolar
questions.explanation: The displayed Moodle feedback lists local and generalized, pitting and non-pitting, and primary and secondary lymphedema. The student checked only the first and third options. This reproduces the feedback key.
